records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Orchard Works!
records.body:
Hi Owen,

Thanks for signing up for Wrenfield. Two things that help teams get going: create a project, and invite at least one teammate from Account Settings -> Members.

Happy to answer anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Account is 6 days old, created first project on day 1 (good early signal, Pro plan), but no invite sent, no key milestone, zero tickets, and no reply to the welcome note [email:26ba6c66]. Silence plus no teammate activity after 5 days suggests slow self-serve progress in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: Your next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Owen,

Nice work getting your first project set up last week — projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them.

The other thing that tends to help teams get moving is bringing in one teammate: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through whatever your team needs next and answer any questions.

Best,
Nadia
